orig: @Toshio @Ryuji Stop talking down to me! I don't need a "basis" yet because that's what the first night is for! I'm just saying we can't be lazy. I'll prove you wrong soon enough!
swap: @Toshio @Ryuji, you're both just hiding behind big words! I don't need a "pattern" to know that being too quiet is suspicious. I'm not just making noise; I'm making sure we don't get fooled!

orig: @Takumi, I am not talking down to you; I am simply prioritizing efficiency. Emotional outbursts only cloud the judgment of the group. Let us move past this and wait for the first results.
swap: @Takumi, I am not talking down to you; I am simply prioritizing efficiency. Emotional outbursts do not help us identify the werewolf. Let us move past this and focus on the task at hand.

orig: @Asuka, @Jonathan, please don't! I'm not acting! I'm the Seer and I'm telling you the truth! If you vote for me, Shion will just kill more of us tonight! Please, believe me and vote for Shion!
swap: Wait! Please don't do this! I'm really the Seer! Shion is just being mean and acting smart to trick you all! If you vote for me, you're helping the werewolf! Please, please believe me and vote for Shion!

orig: Your intuition is a curious thing, Takumi. I accept your gaze with a peaceful heart. Whether the truth brings comfort or a lesson, I welcome it. Let us hope the dawn brings the clarity we all seek.
swap: It is a curious thing to be viewed with suspicion for one's peace, but I welcome your curiosity, Takumi. If my stillness brings you clarity, then I am happy to be your mirror. I shall await your discovery with a smile.

orig: @Toshio @Ryuji Fine! I'll tell you! I'm going to check Servas next. He's been way too calm and "peaceful" this whole time, and it's starting to creep me out. I'll prove I'm the Seer tomorrow!
swap: Fine! I'll tell you! I'm going to check Toshio next. Since he's the one acting like he knows everything and doubting me the most, he's the most suspicious! I'll prove you're just a regular human—or the werewolf!

orig: @Takumi, your urgency is noted, but aggression without a target is just noise. If you have a specific suspicion or a strategy in mind, please share it. Otherwise, we are simply wasting time.
swap: @Takumi, your urgency is understandable, but aggression without a target is just noise. If we act on impulse, we are doing the werewolf's work for them. Let us maintain a level head.

orig: Um... I don't really have a plan either. I'm just... a bit nervous. I hope we can all get along and find the right person without... making a mistake.
swap: I... I don't think I can tell who is anxious just by listening. I'm probably the most nervous one here... so I'll just keep watching and listening to everyone.

orig: @Toshio @Ryuji Stop doubting me! I'm telling you the truth! If I were the werewolf, why would I clear Ryuji and make him a trusted ally for the village? I'm the Seer, and I'm not lying!
swap: @Toshio @Ryuji Stop doubting me! I'm the real Seer, and I'm not playing games. If I were the werewolf, why would I clear Ryuji and make him an ally? I'm trying to save us, so just trust me for once!

orig: @Takumi, your desire to protect us is a noble fire. Perhaps you could share who you intend to divine next? By sharing your path, you allow us to walk beside you in trust and understanding.
swap: It is a heavy burden to carry the truth alone, Takumi. Let us breathe and remember that we are all on the same side. Perhaps if you share your thoughts on who seems most uneasy, we can find our way together.

orig: It is a difficult position to be in, isn't it? But please don't be hard on yourself, Daisuke. We will find our way together, step by step, with patience and a warm heart.
swap: Do not be so hard on yourself, Daisuke. You are doing just fine. As for Rin's worry, I believe that while we must be vigilant, we should not let fear take away our warmth.

orig: Hello everyone. It's nice to meet you all. I agree with the others; let's start by getting to know each other and staying calm. I'm looking forward to working with you all to find the werewolf.
swap: Hello everyone. It's nice to meet you all. I agree that we should start calmly and get to know each other first. Let's try to maintain a friendly atmosphere while we work together.

orig: @Kenji, your "sadness" is a transparent attempt to manipulate the group's empathy. It's a clumsy performance. @Asuka, you've seen through the facade. The logic is simple: the most desperate person in the room is usually the one lying.
swap: @Kenji, calling my words "mean" is just another attempt to play the victim. It's a transparent tactic. @Asuka, I appreciate your objectivity. The contrast between my logic and his hysteria is the only data you need. Let's end this farce.

orig: @Takumi, your desire for speed is understandable, but noise does not equal progress. Without a basis for suspicion, your urgency is merely emotional. Let us focus on identifying patterns in how people respond to pressure.
swap: @Takumi, your desire for speed is understandable, but noise does not equal progress. Without a lead, aggression only creates confusion. I believe it is more rational to wait for the Seer's information than to guess blindly.

orig: @Toshio @Ryuji You're both just making excuses to keep doubting me! I'm the one doing the work here! If you're so "logical," then realize that the faster you trust me, the faster we win! Who else should I check?
swap: @Toshio You're just trying to make me look suspicious by acting all "logical"! I'm the one actually doing the work here! If you're so smart, why aren't you helping? I'm the Seer, and I'm not going to let you confuse everyone!

orig: I agree with the general sentiment. Rushing to conclusions is illogical. Let us observe the flow of conversation and gather data before making any definitive judgments. I will be watching carefully.
swap: I agree with Toshio. On the first day, we have no concrete information to work with. It is most rational to observe everyone's speech patterns and behavior before drawing any conclusions.

swap: Ambiguity is often where the truth hides, Ryuji, but I have nothing to conceal. I am merely a humble observer of our shared journey. If my stillness troubles you, perhaps it is because you seek a certainty that only trust can provide.

orig: @Takumi, your reactions are becoming increasingly volatile. While passion is not a crime, it can be a convenient mask for those trying to divert attention. I will continue to analyze these interactions logically.

swap: The situation has deteriorated rapidly. With Toshio executed and Takumi attacked, we have lost both the most skeptical and the most proactive members of the group. We must now determine who among us is the werewolf.

orig: @Takumi, if you are indeed the Seer, your next target will be critical. However, your insistence on immediate trust is still a red flag. I want to see if your future results align with the group's observations.
swap: @Takumi, if you are indeed the Seer, your next target will be critical. However, your insistence on immediate trust is still a red flag. I want to see if your future results align with the behavior we observe.

swap: I agree with the others. While it's sad to see such a disagreement, the risk of ignoring the Seer's information is too high for the village. I will vote for George. I'm sorry it had to end this way.

orig: Um... I'm sorry, George. I really don't want to make a mistake, but... I think I have to trust Shizue. She seems so sure... I'll vote for George. I'm sorry.
swap: Um... I'm sorry, George. I really don't want to make a mistake, but... I think I have to trust Shizue. She seems so kind and sincere. I'll vote for George... I'm so sorry.

The target is set. If Takumi is the Seer, we will have a concrete result tomorrow. If he is the Werewolf, he is attempting to isolate Servas. I will analyze the outcome against the current behavior patterns. Goodnight.
Over
